question: Major Dhyan Chand was born in which of the following city of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Allahabad.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Major Dhyan Chand** was a **legendary Indian hockey player** who was born on **August 29, 1905**, in** Allahabad, Uttar Pradesh.**
 
• He is widely regarded as one of the **greatest hockey players** of all time and his contribution to the sport is unmatched.
 
• Major Dhyan Chand's real name was **Dhyan Singh** and he was from a family of hockey players.
 
• His father,** Sameshwar Dutt Singh**, was a Subedar in the British Indian Army and played hockey for the army team.
 
• Major Dhyan Chand joined the army himself in **1922** and was soon selected for the Indian Army hockey team.
 
• He went on to represent India in** three Olympic Games** and won **gold medals** in all of them.
 
• He was also a part of the Indian team that won the **1936 Berlin Olympics**, where he scored three goals in the final against Germany.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Allahabad**, the birthplace of Major Dhyan Chand, is a city in **Uttar Pradesh** that is known for its rich history and cultural heritage.

 
 
• It is located at the confluence of the **Ganges, Yamuna, and Saraswati **rivers and is considered one of the** holiest cities** in India.
 
 
 
• **Aligarh** is a city in Uttar Pradesh that is known for its educational institutions, including the famous **Aligarh Muslim University.**
 
• **Lucknow** is the **capital city **of Uttar Pradesh and is known for its rich history, culture, and cuisine.
 
• **Dehradun** is the **capital** city of **Uttarakhand** and is known for its scenic beauty and proximity to the** Himalayas.**
